messages:
toni: FYI npm publish for js-sdk failed on release pipeline. Error: "You must bump the package version before publishing". Looks like regen committed changes but package.json stayed the same.

priya: Ugh. Did typegen actually change the public surface? or was it just docs/ordering/whitespace?

toni: Quick diff shows the generated client signature is identical, but JSDoc param ordering moved:

```diff
-/**
- * createUser(name, opts)
- * @param {string} name
- * @param {object} opts
- */
+/**
+ * createUser(name, options)
+ * @param {string} name
+ * @param {object} options
+ */
```

sam_ci: If only JSDoc identifier changed that's not semver-impacting, but publish guard is strict: any changes in dist/ require version bump. CI expects regen commits to either be empty or accompanied by a version bump.

regen-bot: regen:detected changes in packages/js-sdk/dist -> marking pipeline-blocker.

priya: How did regen produce a JSDoc rename? We didn't touch templates. Could be a template lint auto-fix or a default param rename in the newer typegen template. Which typegen version ran in CI?

toni: Runner used typegen v2.7.0 in the release matrix. Local dev has v2.6.4 and no diffs. So this looks like a minor template change in 2.7.0 that renames param identifier 'opts' -> 'options'.

priya: That's a tooling-only change that shouldn't require a semver bump for the package API, but our release rules are conservative. Short-term fix: bump patch version and publish. Long-term: make the publish pipeline smarter to ignore docs-only diffs.

sam_ci: Proposed immediate steps:
- patch the js-sdk package.json bump + changelog entry "typegen: normalize JSDoc param name (opts->options)"
- run the release job to publish
- follow-up: update release script to detect functional API changes vs JSDoc/template-only changes (compare generated AST vs whitespace/comments)

toni: I'll open the patch PR now with the version bump and changelog. Also adding a note in dev-contrib that contributors should pin typegen to project config to avoid accidental template upgrades.

priya: For the longer fix I can prototype a small tool that strips comments from generated JS and compares the AST of the public exports; if identical, skip mandatory version bump and tag as docs-only. Would prefer a conservative default: still surface warning in the release notes but allow publish.

regen-bot: PR 754 created by @toni -> fix(js-sdk): patch version bump for regen-only docs change. CI: run triggered.

sam_ci: One more action: add a check in devex/release.md that regen CI failures must include a human review step before auto-bumping. We had an automated bump once and it accidentally changed API behavior.

toni: noted. Adding checklist item. Will monitor the PR.

priya: Thanks. If anyone sees similar regen-only diffs (param renames, doc reorder), drop them here and include the typegen version used. We'll track template diffs in CHANGELOG-typegen.md. :memo:
